auth.note: Every outbound request carries applicationId and password in the JSON body. There are no headers, tokens or signatures.

rules: Always tel:-prefixed, no + and no spaces.
May be a masked hash (tel:hu3b84346f...) when number masking is provisioned. Treat as opaque.
tel:all broadcasts to the entire subscribed base (SMS send only).

responseEnvelope.criticalNote: Ideamart returns HTTP 200 for application-level failures. Branch on statusCode, never on the HTTP status alone. S1000 is success.

services.name: SMS Send
services.summary: Send an MT (Mobile Terminated) SMS to one or more subscribers.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as given when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password given when provisioned.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (1.0, 2.0). Defaults to latest.

parameters.name: destinationAddresses
parameters.description: Array of tel:-prefixed addresses. Always an array, even for one recipient. tel:all targets the whole subscribed base.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message body. Over-length messages are split by the platform and charged per part.

parameters.name: sourceAddress
parameters.description: Sender address shown to the user. Must be a provisioned alias or the send fails with E1331.

parameters.name: deliveryStatusRequest
parameters.description: 0 = no delivery report, 1 = request one. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: 0 = Text, 240 = Flash SMS, 245 = Binary (message hex-encoded). Defaults to Text.

parameters.name: chargingAmount
parameters.description: Charging amount for variable-charge SMS services.

responseFields.name: destinationResponses
responseFields.description: Per-recipient results (address, messageId, statusDetail, timeStamp). A multi-recipient send can partially succeed.

rules: destinationAddresses is always an array.
Guard tel:all behind a deliberate, separately-authorised code path.
Keep under 160 GSM-7 characters for one part; Sinhala and Tamil are UCS-2, so budget 70.
Only set deliveryStatusRequest to 1 if you consume the delivery-report callback.

services.name: USSD Send
services.summary: Send a USSD screen to a subscriber inside an active session.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as given when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password given when provisioned.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version. Defaults to latest.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Screen text sent to the handset. ~182 char limit; assume 160.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Session number assigned by the USSD gateway. Echo the one the platform sent you; never generate your own.

parameters.name: ussdOperation
parameters.description: mt-init starts an app-initiated session, mt-cont keeps it open, mt-fin closes it.

parameters.name: destinationAddress
parameters.description: tel:-prefixed subscriber address; may be a hash key.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: 440 = plain ASCII.

responseFields.name: requestId
responseFields.description: Uniquely identifies the request within Ideamart.

rules: Echo the platform's sessionId. A wrong one orphans the session.
Terminal screens must use mt-fin, or the session hangs until the network times it out.
Plain ASCII only (encoding 440) — no emoji, no Sinhala/Tamil script, no smart quotes.
Reply fast: USSD sessions time out in seconds.

services.name: Subscription Register
services.summary: Opt a subscriber in to the application.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version. Defaults to latest.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: 1 = opt in. Documented as a string; numeric 1 is also accepted.

parameters.name: subscriberId
parameters.description: tel:-prefixed subscriber address; may be masked.

responseFields.name: requestId
responseFields.description: Uniquely identifies the request within the SDP.

responseFields.name: subscriptionStatus
responseFields.description: REGISTERED, UNREGISTERED or PENDING. PENDING CHARGE means the subscriber has not been charged yet.

rules: Only call with explicit, recorded consent. Disclose amount and frequency before registering.
E1351 (already registered) is success — the desired state already holds.
A PENDING result is not active yet; wait for the subscription notification before delivering the service.

services.name: Subscription Unregister
services.summary: Opt a subscriber out of the application.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version. Defaults to latest.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: 0 = opt out.

parameters.name: subscriberId
parameters.description: tel:-prefixed subscriber address; may be masked.

responseFields.name: requestId
responseFields.description: Uniquely identifies the request within the SDP.

rules: Unregister must be as easy as register — offer it over MO SMS (STOP/UNSUB/OFF), USSD and in-app.
E1356 (not registered) is success — the desired state already holds.
Honour it immediately, including cancelling queued and scheduled messages.

services.name: Subscription Status
services.summary: Check the current subscription status of one subscriber.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: subscriberId
parameters.description: tel:-prefixed subscriber address; may be masked.

rules: Use for reconciliation, not as a per-request gate — mirror state locally from the subscription notification instead.

services.name: Query Base (subscriber base size)
services.summary: Return the number of subscribers currently registered to the application.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password as received when provisioned.

responseFields.name: baseSize
responseFields.description: Current subscriber base size. Arrives as a string — coerce before arithmetic.

rules: Needs no subscriber and costs nothing — the ideal connectivity and credential smoke test.
baseSize is a string. Parse it.
Poll on a schedule into your own metrics rather than per page load.
Sanity-check it before any tel:all broadcast.

services.name: OTP Request
services.summary: Dispatch a one-time PIN by SMS so a web or app user can be registered from a plain mobile number.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: subscriberId
parameters.description: tel:-prefixed mobile number the user typed.

parameters.name: applicationHash
parameters.description: A UUID you generate per request, for tracing.

parameters.name: applicationMetaData
parameters.description: client (MOBILEAPP | WebSite | DESKTOP), device, os, appCode (package name / store URL / page URL / download URL).

responseFields.name: referenceNo
responseFields.description: Pass to OTP Verify. Keep server-side, in the session — never send it to the client.

rules: Rate-limit per number AND per IP, or the app becomes an SMS-bombing tool at your expense.
One OTP is valid for 60 minutes.
Always call from a backend with a static IP.

services.name: OTP Verify
services.summary: Verify a PIN and receive the masked subscriberId to use with every other API.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password as received when provisioned.

parameters.name: referenceNo
parameters.description: From the OTP Request response. Server-side only.

parameters.name: otp
parameters.description: The PIN the user entered.

responseFields.name: subscriberId
responseFields.description: Masked subscriber identifier. Use this for SMS, Subscription and Charging from now on.

rules: Maximum 3 attempts per OTP — enforce it on your side too.
Never log the OTP or the referenceNo.
Store the returned masked subscriberId as the user's Ideamart identity.

services.name: CaaS Direct Debit
services.summary: Charge a specific amount from a subscriber's mobile account. Moves real money.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID generated when provisioning.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password authenticating the application.

parameters.name: externalTrxId
parameters.description: Your transaction ID, mapping request to response. Max 32 characters. Persist BEFORE calling — it is the idempotency key.

parameters.name: subscriberId
parameters.description: MSISDN or hash key of the subscriber to charge.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Amount to charge, sent as a string. Hold as a decimal type in your own code.

parameters.name: paymentInstrument
parameters.description: The account the debit is performed on, e.g. MobileAccount.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Account of the payment instrument.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the amount. LKR for Sri Lanka.

responseFields.name: externalTrxId
responseFields.description: Echo of your ID. Assert it matches what you sent.

responseFields.name: internalTrxId
responseFields.description: Payment gateway transaction ID. Persist it — support and reconciliation use this.

responseFields.name: referenceId
responseFields.description: 8-digit number for the payment request, where an external charging menu is involved.

rules: The amount must be pre-agreed and disclosed to the user before they subscribe.
Persist externalTrxId before the HTTP call, then update the row from the response.
Never retry with a fresh externalTrxId — a timeout does not mean the charge failed.
E1379 (already completed) is success. E1406 (user rejected) must never be retried.
Amount and currency come from server-side config, never from client input.

services.name: CaaS Query Balance
services.summary: Query a subscriber's remaining chargeable balance.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID generated when provisioning.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password authenticating the application.

parameters.name: subscriberId
parameters.description: MSISDN or username of the subscriber being queried. The official sample omits the tel: prefix here, unlike every other service; send it tel:-prefixed for consistency — that is what works in practice.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Account of the payment instrument. Single value per request.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Must be LKR.

responseFields.name: chargeableBalance
responseFields.description: Remaining balance (prepaid) or credit limit minus outstanding bill (postpaid). A string — parse as decimal.

rules: Requires the Enable Query Balance Requests toggle in CaaS provisioning.
Advisory only — the balance can change before the debit lands. Always handle E1378 on the debit anyway.
chargeableBalance is a string — parse as decimal, never compare a float for equality.

services.name: LBS Get Location
services.summary: Return a subscriber's network-derived location. Works on feature phones; accuracy in hundreds of metres.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Application ID from provisioning.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password from provisioning.

parameters.name: subscriberId
parameters.description: MSISDN whose location is requested. One subscriber per request. May be masked.

parameters.name: serviceType
parameters.description: MLP service type. Only IMMEDIATE is currently supported.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (1.0, 2.0).

parameters.name: responseTime
parameters.description: Accepted delay. Capped by provisioning — you may request your level or weaker, never stronger.

parameters.name: horizontalAccuracy
parameters.description: Required accuracy in metres. 100 is the strictest and highest precedence.

parameters.name: freshness
parameters.description: Required freshness. HIGH_LOW is the highest precedence.

responseFields.name: messageId
responseFields.description: Uniquely identifies the request within the SDP. Always present.

responseFields.name: freshness
responseFields.description: Actual age of the fix, in minutes.

responseFields.name: timeStamp
responseFields.description: Transaction date/time. Present on success only.

rules: Uses the api.dialog.lk host, not api.ideamart.io.
Omit the QoS fields unless you know your provisioned level — requesting above it fails with E1367.
Coordinates are strings and absent on failure. Sanity-check against Sri Lanka (lat ~6-10, lon ~79-82) before use.
horizontalAccuracy is a radius — treat the position as a circle, never a point.
Requires explicit, purpose-specific consent. Consent to receive SMS is not consent to be located.

callbacks.name: MO SMS Receive
callbacks.summary: Fires when a subscriber texts your shortcode with your keyword.

fields.name: applicationId
fields.description: Your application ID — verify it matches.

fields.name: sourceAddress
fields.description: Sender address, masked if masking is enabled.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Message as sent by the user, including the keyword.

rules: Recognise STOP / UNSUB / OFF and honour them by calling Unregister.
Do not perform a destructive or chargeable action on the content of one MO SMS alone.

callbacks.name: SMS Delivery Status Report
callbacks.summary: Final delivery state of an MT SMS sent with deliveryStatusRequest 1.

fields.name: timeStamp
fields.description: Documented as yyMMddHHmm; samples show yyyyMMddHHmmss. Parse both lengths.

fields.name: requestId
fields.description: Ties the report to the original send.

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Ideamart uses the long forms; the SMPP gateway uses the abbreviated ones. Accept both.

rules: ACCEPTED is not DELIVERED — it only means the network took the message.
Reports can arrive out of order, late, twice, or never.

callbacks.name: USSD Receive
callbacks.summary: Fires when a subscriber dials your code or presses a key.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.description: Session identifier — echo this back on every send.

fields.name: ussdOperation
fields.description: mo-init starts a session, mo-cont is subsequent input.

fields.name: message
fields.description: What the user dialled or typed.

rules: The response body is only an acknowledgement — the screen the user sees comes from a separate POST /ussd/send.
Sessions time out in seconds. Acknowledge before doing any work.

callbacks.name: Subscription Notification
callbacks.summary: Fires whenever a subscription changes, including changes you did not initiate.

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Charging frequency for the subscription, e.g. Monthly.

rules: This is the authoritative source of subscription state — consume it and keep a local mirror instead of polling getStatus.

callbacks.name: Charging Notification
callbacks.summary: Reports the outcome of every executed charging request.

fields.name: externalTrxId
fields.description: Your transaction ID — the match key.

rules: This is your reconciliation channel — resolve every charge left UNKNOWN after a timeout here.
A duplicate that double-counts revenue is a real bug. Deduplicate on externalTrxId.

configuration.action: Provisioning or credentials are wrong. Fix the portal — code changes will not help. Alert on these in production; the integration is down, not one request.

client.action: Your payload is wrong, or the user gave bad input. Fix the request or prompt the user.

user-state.action: The user is not eligible right now. Communicate; do not retry in a loop.

transient.action: Platform-side. Exponential backoff with jitter, capped attempts, then dead-letter.

practices.title: Never hardcode applicationId or password
practices.detail: Environment variables only, through one config module, validated at startup. Not in source, not in a client bundle, not in a committed file, not in a log, not in git history. Never prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC_ / VITE_ / REACT_APP_.

practices.title: Never call Ideamart from client-side code
practices.detail: Clients call your backend; your backend calls Ideamart. Credentials are a shared secret and the platform enforces IP whitelisting, which a mobile client cannot satisfy.

practices.title: Explicit consent before register or charge
practices.detail: Record who consented, when, through which channel, and the exact wording shown. Disclose amount, currency and frequency first. Ideamart suspends applications over this.

practices.title: Charging must be idempotent
practices.detail: One externalTrxId per logical charge, persisted before the call, reused on retry. Never re-roll it — that double-charges a real person.

practices.title: Branch on statusCode, not the HTTP status
practices.detail: Ideamart returns HTTP 200 for application-level failures. Checking res.ok reports failures as successes.

practices.title: Treat subscriberId as opaque
practices.detail: With masking enabled it is a hash, not a phone number. Do not parse it, strip it, or assume a length. Store and send back exactly what you received.

practices.title: Never ship rejectUnauthorized: false
practices.detail: Some hosts serve an incomplete certificate chain. Supply the missing intermediate CA explicitly; disabling verification exposes the credentials that can charge your subscribers.

practices.title: Acknowledge callbacks before doing work
practices.detail: Respond S1000 immediately, then process asynchronously. USSD sessions time out in seconds; slow handlers cause retries, duplicates and dropped sessions.

practices.title: Every callback handler must be idempotent
practices.detail: All five callbacks can arrive more than once. Deduplicate on the documented key. A duplicate charging notification that double-counts revenue is a real bug.

practices.title: Never trust the callback body
practices.detail: It is unauthenticated JSON from the public internet. Validate the schema, verify applicationId, restrict by source IP, rate-limit, and never treat a callback as authorisation.

practices.title: A static egress IP is a hard requirement
practices.detail: IP whitelisting is enforced with E1303. Serverless platforms with rotating egress need a NAT gateway or fixed-IP proxy. Decide before choosing a host.

practices.title: Guard tel:all
practices.detail: A broadcast to the entire subscriber base must never be reachable from an ordinary code path. Require an explicit, separately-authorised call and sanity-check against Query Base first.

practices.title: USSD session state must be shared across instances
practices.detail: An in-process Map breaks the moment you scale horizontally or deploy. Use Redis or equivalent, with a ~2 minute TTL.

practices.title: Never log secrets or unmasked subscriber data
practices.detail: Log requestId, sessionId, externalTrxId and statusCode. Never the password, OTP, referenceNo, or an unmasked subscriberId. Mask in the logger, not at each call site.

practices.title: Set an explicit timeout on every call
Retry only transient codes and transport errors
practices.detail: Exponential backoff with jitter, capped attempts, then dead-letter. Never retry a definitive E13xx, and never retry a debit with a new externalTrxId.

practices.title: Mirror subscription state locally
practices.detail: Consume the subscription notification instead of calling getStatus on every request.

practices.title: Use a decimal type for money
practices.detail: Never a binary float. Amount and currency come from server-side config or a server-side price lookup, never from client input.
